messages:
Alicia: AtlasBank POC - quick: Rust streaming SDK failing behind their corporate proxy (TLS inspect). They also want a concrete func/tool JSON example and a rough burst pricing. Who can own?

Sam: I'll own. Are they on hosted for the POC?

Alicia: Yes hosted.

Rana: Common Rust issue: proxy MITM breaks native-tls. Short fixes: 1) Ask Atlas infra to allowlist our egress IPs; 2) for POC only, provide a CA bundle path via env var to the SDK; 3) we can provide short-lived mTLS certs.

Rana: Tiny Rust SSE snippet we gave them:
```
use tokio_tungstenite::connect_async;
async fn run(key:&str){ let (ws,_) = connect_async("wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream").await.unwrap(); /* send & read */ }
```

Rana: Tool JSON sample the model should emit: {"tool":"charge","args":{"amount_cents":1250,"currency":"USD","trace_id":"atlas-2026-03-21"}}. Validate with serde before calling payment API.

Jordan: If allowlist not possible, we can spin a staging edge or provide mTLS for the POC. Also recommend app pings every 15s to avoid proxy idle drops.

Nina: Security quick: hosted uses AWS KMS (HSM), SOC2 Type II available, SAML/OIDC supported. I'll DM the packet link.

Kevin: Pricing sketch: hosted bursts (1k TPS spikes, ~150 tokens) ~$18k-$30k/mo; Dedicated steady 1k TPS ~$60k-$90k/mo. Will send a spreadsheet.

infra-bot: Staging namespace `atlas-poc-smoketest` created, key `REDS_SMOKE_01` expires 24h.

Alicia: Thanks team — we'll run a quick smoke over their proxy tomorrow and share logs. I'll schedule a sync and attach runbook.
